why_off: Staged by lane agntcy-catalog-20260928. OFF by default: owm.py reads fleet/owm/owm-registry.json only, and nothing below is in it. Turning it on is an integrator step after the owner OK on naming a third-party directory in internal state; the OWM public snapshot must never carry per-agent rows.
enable_steps: 2. On the lanes pod: install the job.cron line below (flock on /workspace/locks/lanes-heavy.lock; the script skips when under 2 GB free).
3. Append subject below to fleet/owm/owm-registry.json subjects[] and job below to fleet/automation/JOBS.json; re-run fleet/owm/test_owm.py.

subject.label: agent-directory listing: verbatim snapshot and record-vs-locator parity (weekly)
subject.claim: The newest parity aggregate was built from the newest verbatim snapshot of the agent-directory listing, and that snapshot read the whole listing (unique records equal the declared total of the listing).

sources.label: newest verbatim ARD snapshot manifest (copied from the pod; a few KB)
newest parity aggregate (counts only; names no agent, server or company)

job.host: lanes pod (the snapshot is about 150 MB: not Oracle, not the Mac)
job.why_tuesday: the directory import runs Mondays 00:00Z (agntcy/dir .github/workflows/import-records.yaml, cron 0 0 * * 1); Tuesday reads the settled listing

claim_watch_subject_source.subjects: one per record CID; identity = CID (content address), so a changed record is a new subject, never an edit
change_events: ADDED: a CID in this snapshot and not in the previous one
REMOVED: a CID in the previous snapshot and not in this one
DECLARED_VERSION_CHANGED: same MCP server name, a new CID with another declared version
TRUST_LABEL_CHANGED: agntcy.dir.trust.v1.Status {trusted, verified} differs for the same CID
LOCATOR_STATE_CHANGED: an ads-parity check state differs for the same CID and locator
claim_watch_subject_source.publication: HELD: events name third parties; internal state only until the owner gives a per-company OK
